docs: Rakurai Tip Manager Program: users send tips to one of eight tip accounts, validators periodically drain them
and tips are split between the configured tip receiver and an client commission account.

instructions.name: change_client
docs: Changes the client and its commission by first draining all pending tips (distributing shares to the tip receiver
and old client) and then setting the new client and its commission.

instructions.name: change_tip_receiver
docs: Deprecated: use [`change_tip_receiver_v2`].

instructions.name: change_tip_receiver_v1
docs: Deprecated: use [`change_tip_receiver_v2`].

accounts.name: new_tip_receiver
docs: Rakurai tip revenue share PDA (`TipsCollectionAccount` / TCA) for this validator vote.

accounts.name: record_authority
docs: receiving TCA's `record_authority`; the seeds constraint guarantees only this program can sign.

instructions.name: change_tip_receiver_v2
docs: Mirror of `change_tip_receiver_v1` for **TCAV1** (`REVENUE_SHARE_V1`).
Commission on the drain uses tip-manager global config; after drain, syncs global from the
**new** TCAV1. Records against legacy TCA or TCAV1 old receiver.

accounts.name: new_tip_receiver
docs: Rakurai tip TCAV1 PDA for this validator vote.

instructions.name: close_rakurai_tip_manager
docs: Closes all Tip manager program accounts (8 tip accounts + config account) and reclaim rent.
Only the tip manager config authority can invoke this instruction.

accounts.name: tip_manager_config
docs: singleton account

instructions.name: initialize_rakurai_tip_manager
docs: Initializes the Rakurai Tip Manager by creating the singleton config PDA and eight Rakurai tip PDAs,
this instruction must be executed exactly once.

accounts.name: tip_manager_config
docs: singleton account

errors.name: MaxCommissionBpsExceeded

errors.name: RakuraiSchedulerNotEnabled

errors.name: Deprecated

Eight accounts are maintained to reduce account write-lock contention.

fields.name: max_epoch_entries
